title: Fun Chocolate Making Class With a Local Chef in Dallas
includes: A fun, hands-on 2-hour cooking class led by a talented local chef.
All ingredients and cooking tools provided.
Expert instruction, tips and chef secrets you’ll use daily.
An authentic experience hosted at a local public brewery, distillery, craft beer bar or wine bar.
Drinks are available for purchase at the bar of the venue. Prices range from $3 to $20 (not included)
policies: This cooking class is designed to accommodate a variety of dietary needs! Please let us know in advance, and we'll do our best to tailor the experience to suit your preferences and restrictions.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Chocolate gets a serious upgrade in this hands-on class. You’ll start from scratch by combining semi-sweet chocolate, heavy cream, butter and vanilla extract into a rich, silky ganache. After chilling the mixture, you’ll learn how to roll and shape it into neat truffles before giving each one its own finishing touch with cocoa powder, chocolate sprinkles, crushed cookies or chopped pecans and almonds. Chef Dee’s beginner-friendly approach makes the techniques easy to follow, whether you’re already comfortable in the kitchen or still figuring out which way the whisk goes. You’ll spend two relaxed hours making, tasting and learning, then leave with a beautiful assortment of handcrafted chocolate truffles. Store-bought chocolates are officially on notice.
